test_name: Verify Test Plan Search Functionality with Valid and Invalid Inputs
description: This scenario tests the behavior of the search functionality on the Test Plans page by providing valid, invalid, and edge-case inputs. It ensures that the search feature filters results correctly and handles invalid inputs gracefully.
steps: 2. Verify the visibility of the search input field with placeholder 'Search for Test Plans'.
3. Type a valid search term (e.g., 'Regression') into the search box.
4. Press Enter or wait for the results to auto-update.
5. Verify that the results displayed match the search term.
7. Type an invalid search term (e.g., 'zzzzzzzz') and press Enter.
8. Verify that no results are displayed and an appropriate message (e.g., 'No test plans found') is shown.
10. Type a search term with special characters (e.g., '@#$%^&*') and press Enter.
11. Verify that the system handles the input without crashing and displays either no results or a validation message.
12. Test entering an extremely long string (e.g., 500+ characters).
13. Verify the input field's handling of large inputs (e.g., truncation, error message).
14. Perform a case-sensitivity test by entering a search term in uppercase and lowercase.
15. Verify that search results are consistent regardless of case.
16. Use the browser's refresh function and verify that any applied search filter is cleared.
17. Validate that resetting the search box restores the full list of test plans.
expected_results: Search results correctly filter based on the valid search term.
No results are displayed for invalid search terms, with an appropriate message shown.
Special character inputs do not cause crashes or unhandled exceptions.
Long inputs are handled gracefully without breaking the UI.
edge_cases: Enter a string with only special characters as input.
Use an empty search input and press Enter.
Simulate slow network conditions during search filtering.
dependencies: At least one test plan exists in the system.
The search functionality is fully implemented.
The user has access to the Test Plans page.

api_interactions.mock_response: List of test plans filtered by search query

performance_metrics: Search results update within 1s of input submission.
accessibility_requirements: WCAG 2.1: Ensure the search input has a visible label or aria-label.
WCAG 2.1: Test keyboard navigation and ensure the search box is focusable.
WCAG 2.1: Verify screen reader announces the input field and search results.
